fusions.name: Languid Dart
fusions.desc: Drifts a spore at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, with a 40% chance to leave it [Damped] for 6 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Ebb Push
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 12 damage, pushes the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Tide Balm
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Calm Colony
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, you regain 2 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
